audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagree with the packet and with their own prose: rows 0 and 1 print Graves above whys that say "even farming" and "stays even", row 3 prints Skill above "Your Levels 4-5 R engage ... swings the window to you", row 6 prints Skill above "you out-brawl a squishy, peel-less Graves".
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Skill, Graves, Zaahen, Skill, Graves, Zaahen, and the mirror audit records win[0], win[1], win[3], win[6] plus the matching phases sides being aligned to it with ratings 5/5/6/4/5/6/3 from Graves's side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 flipped in both layers as matched pairs; ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's — 5/5/4/6/5/4/7 from Zaahen's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects says it outright: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0. The page names Quickdraw as the matchup-defining cooldown eleven times without ever stating it.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12, and the kit says basic attacks lower its cooldown and refresh the resistance boost — so "wait for his E" is only true if you also deny him autos, which is the concrete instruction that was missing. Smoke Screen is 26/24/22/20/18, by far his longest lane cooldown. End of the Line 13s at rank 1, Collateral Damage 100/80/60 against Grim Deliverance's 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw's 16s and its auto-attack refund, Smoke Screen's 26s and Grim Deliverance's 110s written into phases[3], phases[6], the spikes, mid and breakdown.cooldowns, each as a wait-for-X-then-Y line.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) "Buckshot" is not a Graves ability — his Q is End of the Line (three fields). (b) Smoke Screen is called a blind in three fields; it reduces sight range, it does not stop autos from hitting. (c) "double-shot autos" — the passive fires 4 bullets. (d) "Final Retribution" is not Zaahen's R (Grim Deliverance) and "Golden Onslaught" is not his E (Aureate Rush).
audit.why: Kit text for W: "creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range" — no blind flag anywhere on the ability. This is the costliest error on the page: a player told they are blinded will stop auto-attacking during the exact trade they should be winning. The mirror audit independently removed the same blind claim. Passive: "Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units" — the bullets not passing through units also means standing behind your own minions cuts his damage.
audit.corrected: End of the Line named, Smoke Screen described as a nearsight that hides him rather than disarming you, 4-bullet autos stated, and Zaahen's real names used. Determination's revive added to the late-game rows, which is the fact that actually wins the 2-item fight.

notes: The most dangerous error in this slice so far: three fields told the player Smoke Screen blinds them. It reduces sight range — his autos and yours both keep landing — so a player who stops attacking inside the smoke throws the trade they were winning. The mirror audit removed the same claim independently, which is good corroboration. 'Buckshot' is also a fabrication (his Q is End of the Line), and the recurring Zaahen fabrications 'Final Retribution' and 'Golden Onslaught' appear here too, now in five of the five matchups I have audited. packet.defects called out zero cooldown-sequencing lines; every rewritten string now carries a wait-for-X-then-Y.
